payload.title: Mirror FrickDesign (packages/design-swift) as a remote-consumable SwiftPM package
payload.description: FrickSwift is auto-mirrored to github.com/briannadoubt/FrickSwift and consumable as a remote SwiftPM dependency, but FrickDesign (packages/design-swift/Sources/FrickDesign — base SwiftUI kit: FrickButton/Badge/StatusChip/Metric/DataTable/ListDetailShell/SegmentedPicker/DatePicker/Chart*, tokens in Generated/FrickTokens.swift) is NOT. It only exists inside the monorepo and is not exposed as a product of the FrickSwift mirror. Zavro iOS (Aquarius AQ-91 ZavroUI) must consume FrickDesign remotely without vendoring. FIX: either (a) auto-mirror packages/design-swift -> github.com/briannadoubt/FrickDesign with its own Package.swift exposing a FrickDesign library product, or (b) add a FrickDesign target+product to the existing FrickSwift mirror's Package.swift. Blocks Aquarius AQ-91.
